patthana15.56:1.1: Nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ.
patthana15.56:2.1: Bhāvanāya pahātabbahetukaṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nabhāvanāya pahātabbahetuko naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā… hetuyā tīṇi. (Abyākatamūlaṃ dve.)
